title: U.S. House · Ohio's 14th District
area: Northeast Ohio, including Lake, Geauga and Ashtabula counties and part of eastern Cuyahoga County.

context.text: Incumbent David Joyce (R) defeated Nicole Frenchko in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary. Maria Jukic (D) defeated Bill O'Neill and Carl Setzer in the Democratic primary.

summary.text: David Joyce is the Republican incumbent seeking re-election in Ohio's 14th Congressional District, which he has represented since 2013. He chairs the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Financial Services and General Government and chairs the Republican Governance Group.

record.text: Chairs the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Financial Services and General Government (119th Congress, 2025-2026), also sitting on the Defense subcommittee.
Served as ranking member of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Interior, Environment, and Related Agencies and on the House Committee on Ethics in the 117th Congress (2021-2022).

summary.text: Maria Jukic is the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 14th Congressional District. She is an attorney and small-business owner.

background.text: Earned a high school diploma from Villa Angela Academy, a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame, a graduate degree from John Carroll University, and a law degree from Cleveland State University College of Law.
Works as an attorney and small-business owner.

researchNotes: Neither candidate has completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey and no campaign-website statement of issues was available via Ballotpedia for this race, so priorities and positions are omitted rather than inferred; Ballotpedia's biography section for Joyce contains no independent text beyond his committee record. Federal key votes and FEC finance totals for Joyce are added separately.
